answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to regain engagement geometry against B0100 by converting its fast eastbound extension into a sustained left, descending reversal, progressively reducing its heading error to the opponent astern; the turn begins as the comparable-altitude B-launched missile disappears, consistent with ending a drag phase.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to survive by keeping B0100 and the nearby B0100-launched missile in a prolonged tail chase, sustaining a high-speed east-to-northeast extension while descending and banking; both remain astern, the missile closes only modestly near A0200’s altitude, and A0200 retains its sole recorded missile.
